question:
The following pie chart shows the percentage number of students who play different sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/775ccc7189100d090ebfe4102e6442729d8689e3ac3eb51d192d7e245d6f7079.png] 

If the total number of students are 500, then how many students play cricket?
solution:
**Given:**

Pie-chart showing the number of students who played different sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/775ccc7189100d090ebfe4102e6442729d8689e3ac3eb51d192d7e245d6f7079.png] 

**Calculations:**

Total students = 500

Number of students who played cricket

= 21% of 500

= 0.21 × 500

= 105

**Hence, The Required value is 105.**
